title: Question Bank
description: NCLEX-style practice by topic. Every question explains the right answer and why the others are wrong.

questions.stem: A nurse is caring for a patient with heart failure. Which finding requires immediate intervention?

options.text: Weight gain of 1 lb in one week

questions.explanation: Hypoxemia can indicate impaired oxygenation and requires immediate assessment and intervention.

why.B: Mild peripheral edema can occur with heart failure.
why.C: A 1 lb gain over a week is less concerning than acute hypoxemia.
why.D: Fatigue with activity can occur with heart failure.
